author: Davidgo5867

english.text: My activities on the Web are mainly for self-promotion. It's not really a public service, as the audience is merely incidental and I might be solipsistic. It's a window for vanity with the aim of promoting my own hobbies. If there's an audience, then fine, but if none, then fine, too. If you think that the information is helpful or entertaining, then "it's good for you."

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 ge3 wut6 dung6 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 wai6 zo2 zi6 ngo5 syun1 cyun4。nei1 go3 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 gung1 gung6 fuk6 mou6，jan1 wai6 gun1 zung3 zi2 hai6 ngau5 jin4，ji4 ngo5 ho2 nang4 hai6 gu1 duk6 zyu2 ji6。nei1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 heoi1 wing4 ge3 coeng1 hau2，muk6 dik1 hai6 syun1 cyun4 ngo5 zi6 gei2 ge3 si3 hou3。jyu4 gwo2 jau5 gun1 zung3，gam2 dou1 hou2，daan6 jyu4 gwo2 mou5，gam2 dou1 hou2。jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gok3 dak1 ni1 di1 zi1 seon3 jau5 jung6 waak6 ze2 jau5 ceoi3，gam2 zau6「deoi3 nei5 hou2」。
text: 我喺網上嘅活動主要係為咗自我宣傳。呢個唔係真係一個公共服務，因為觀眾只係偶然，而我可能係孤獨主義。呢個係一個虛榮嘅窗口，目的係宣傳我自己嘅嗜好。如果有觀眾，噉都好，但如果冇，噉都好。如果你覺得呢啲資訊有用或者有趣，噉就「對你好」。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This 8th of May of 2025 is sunny warm. In the morning was my 6th walking voyage this spring to the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road. I was noticing a big tree which reminded me of the jacaranda tree because of the purple flowers, but it isn't jacaranda. I went to the big worship hall in the church and was noticing the multicoloured stained glass in front. The hall was almost empty. A lady lit a candle. There are Filipinos in this parish. At the smaller Adoration Chapel, 'twas more crowded. (My Uncle Sonny in Los Angeles habitually went to Roman Catholic church every day when he was alive. He was Filipino hybridized with white and black American. But he looked more white in reality.) Homebound, I spent a few minutes at a grove of trees. Sometimes, the trees are the temple that all I need. I'm Syncretic by religion, really, tending towards Buddhism-Animism, but I don't discount other belief systems. It's like potpourri.

text: 呢個2025年5月8號係晴朗溫暖嘅。朝早係我今年春天第 6 次行路去聖阿爾本斯道嘅羅馬天主教教堂。我留意到有棵大樹，因為紫色嘅花，令我諗起藍花楹樹，但係佢唔係藍花楹。我去到教堂入面個大崇拜堂，留意到前面個多色嘅彩色玻璃。 個大堂幾乎係空嘅。有個女士點咗支蠟燭。呢個教區入面有菲律賓人喺細啲嘅崇拜教堂，就比較擠逼啲。（我喺洛杉磯嘅桑尼叔叔喺佢生前習慣每日去羅馬天主教教堂。佢係同白人同黑人美國人混血嘅菲律賓人。但係佢喺現實入面睇落比較白人。）返到屋企，我喺一片樹林度過咗幾分鐘。有時，啲樹就係我所需要嘅廟宇。 我係宗教上嘅 Syncretic , 真係，傾向佛教 - 動物主義，但我唔會折扣其他信仰體系。就好似百花香噉。
